posts.zh:
dsh-recall-unread 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在输入框上方提供「未读消息」条带，可在模型读取前撤回已发送但尚未被读取的文字消息。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e7a403c285717975f447.html
posts.en:
dsh-recall-unread is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds a strip above the composer to recall sent-but-unread (steering) text messages before the model reads them.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e7a403c285717975f447.html
